WITH temp_table AS (
SELECT #{areaMaterial.mixArea,jdbcType=VARCHAR} mix_area, #{areaMaterial.materialName,jdbcType=VARCHAR} material_name FROM dual
) SELECT a.mix_area, a.material_name, a.machine_code, m.MID_STATUS, m.NIGHT_STATUS, m.DAY_STATUS FROM T_ACCESSORIES_MACHINE a INNER JOIN t_lhfl_machine m ON a.machine_code = m.machine_code and m.status = '0' and m.del_flag = '0' WHERE a.DEL_FLAG= '0'
AND a.material_name IN (SELECT material_name FROM temp_table)
order by a.mix_area, a.material_name, a.machine_order desc
SELECT MIX_AREA, MACHINE_CODE, MACHINE_NAME, CLASS_SHIFT, CAPACITY, STATUS, MID_STATUS, NIGHT_STATUS, DAY_STATUS FROM T_LHFL_MACHINE WHERE DEL_FLAG = '0' AND MIX_AREA = #{mixArea}

SELECT MACHINE_CODE, MACHINE_NAME, STATUS, MID_STATUS, NIGHT_STATUS, DAY_STATUS FROM T_MIX_MACHINE WHERE DEL_FLAG = '0'
AND MIX_AREA = #{mixArea}

SELECT tfm.MIX_AREA, tfm.GLUE, tfm.MACHINE_CODE, tfm.MACHINE_ORDER, CASE WHEN M.MID_STATUS = '0' THEN 'TRUE' ELSE 'FALSE' END MID_STATUS, CASE WHEN M.NIGHT_STATUS = '0' THEN 'TRUE' ELSE 'FALSE' END NIGHT_STATUS, CASE WHEN M.DAY_STATUS = '0' THEN 'TRUE' ELSE 'FALSE' END DAY_STATUS FROM t_formula_machine tfm INNER JOIN t_mix_machine m ON m.machine_code = tfm.machine_code AND m.status = '0' AND m.del_flag = '0' WHERE tfm.del_flag = '0' AND tfm.mix_area = #{mixArea} ORDER BY GLUE, MACHINE_ORDER
